item.title: NDP confirms five contestants for leadership race to replace Jagmeet Singh
item.description: OTTAWA — Five candidates have met the final requirements in the NDP’s leadership election and will have their names on the ballot when party members choose a new leader for the beleaguered party. item.title: Cascades selling packaging plant to Richmond-based Crown Paper Group in a deal worth $65.5M
item.description: Cascades Inc. has agreed to sell a packaging plant to Crown Paper Group, located in Richmond, B.C.

item.title: Suspected dollar-store shoplifter arrested after pulling hypodermic needle on staff
item.description: The Vancouver Police Department (VPD) says it has arrested a man who allegedly brandished a hypodermic needle at staff at a downtown dollar store.

item.title: Vancouver-based Hootsuite bracing for protest over U.S. Homeland Security, ICE contract
item.description: Hootsuite is preparing for a large protest outside its HQ Friday afternoon, amid growing backlash over a contract tied to U.S. immigration enforcement.

item.title: Richmond RCMP issues appeal for info in 1985 homicide
item.description: 21-year-old Kim Stolberg was found stabbed to death in 1985, and the Richmond RCMP is renewing its appeal for information.

item.title: Baby seal rescued after found with netting wrapped around her neck
